name: application-admin
title: 应用层：管理与运维业务
description: 收敛管理端、配置、升级、邮件和审计相关业务，明确权限、失败和可观测性边界。
creator: wanfeng
notes: 2026-09-25 specification audit and decision closure: consumes domain, infrastructure, identity, notes, content and publishing contracts directly. Preserve the public anonymous /suggestion wire baseline. User adopted all Q-A1..Q-A6 recommendations: Addr is optional strict contact email (254 bytes), Suggestion is valid UTF-8/nonblank (2000 runes/8192 bytes), feedback uses optional 32-char lowercase-hex submissionId with actor-scoped receipt and 30-day terminal retention, feedbackRecipients is a validated internal list capped at 20, admin feedback/broadcast return durable enqueue success with legacy HTTP 200/Re shape, backup uses non-public mongodb_backup root with 30-copy/20-GiB retention and 100000-file/10-GiB source/4-GiB archive budgets, restore is same configured database only, and new comment events use typed metadata/index with strict read-only legacy compatibility and explicit migration. Feedback and admin broadcast mail use durable outbox delivery; transport failure does not roll back persisted feedback and request-path fire-and-forget goroutines are forbidden. Current comment outbox state machine exists in app/db and BlogService; admin owns typed comment transport, metadata/index compatibility, cancellation read-back and redacted SMTP evidence, while publishing owns comment permission/recipient/combined mutation. PDF ownership remains descriptor-only: admin validates configuration and allow policy, while application-content exclusively owns renderer process, sandbox, timeout, artifacts and cleanup. Decisions are frozen; implementation and real-environment evidence remain open.
